mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week rise in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility signals a durable return of commuting and out-of-home routines; this lifts weekday retail footfall, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continuing to rise for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility exceeds +15%, it indicates a behavioral shift to outdoor leisure that substitutes for indoor retail trips, causing RETAIL_REC to plateau or decline over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while PARKS remains above +15% for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise of GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT indicates that essential shopping trips are expanding into broader retail trips; this interaction amplifies retail recovery, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days when both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT rise together for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In an easing-restrictions regime, declining RESIDENTIAL mobility (people leaving home) frees up time for retail and recreation trips, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +15% but RETAIL_REC declines over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal summer onset in Madrid increases outdoor socializing and tourism, lifting retail and recreation independently of pandemic trends; the recent rise in PARKS confirms seasonal outdoor activity, predicting higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the next 28 days despite PARKS continuing to rise seasonally.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in WORKPLACES above -40% signals that office return is robust enough to support lunchtime and after-work retail spending, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next week.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES remains above -40% for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC declines over the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: The divergence between rising PARKS and falling RESIDENTIAL indicates a substitution from home-based leisure to outdoor activity, which reduces indoor retail trips and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while PARKS rises and RESIDENTIAL falls for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Under a reopening regime with TRANSIT recovering above -50%, retail mobility follows transit with a lag; the current TRANSIT level and trend predict RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains above -50% for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days.
